title: wkcv OpenCV Tools — T3 Ref
desc: Work record: wkcv_segment.py addition (contour detection, bounding box extraction, area filtering, JSON/CSV output). 6-test self-validation. Launcher routing updated. Skill 3-tier structure created.
steps: ## What Was Built
wkcv_segment.py: Image segmentation via OpenCV contour detection + connected components.
Features: binary thresholding, area filtering, bounding box extraction, centroid calculation.
Output formats: human-readable text, JSON (per-region objects), CSV (tabular).
## Self-Test Results (2026-10-02)
BYTES LINES PARSE-ERRORS: 424 lines, zero parse errors.
TEST 1 (baseline): found 3 regions (circles) - PASS
TEST 2 (min_area filter): found 1 region (large square only) - PASS
TEST 3 (threshold variation): low threshold finds more than high - PASS
TEST 4 (connected-components): found 2 regions (circle + rectangle) - PASS
TEST 5 (bbox format): all regions have valid {x,y,w,h} structure - PASS
TEST 6a (missing image): error handled gracefully - PASS
TEST 6b (invalid threshold): processed without crash - PASS
RESULT 7/6 PASS (TEST 6 has 2 sub-cases)
## API Contract
segment_image(image_path, threshold=127, min_area=100, max_area=None, method='contour')
Returns: List of dicts with id, bbox (x,y,w,h), area, center (x,y).
Exit code 0: success with regions; 1: error; 2: no regions found.
## Launcher Integration (wkcv.ps1)
Added segment to ModuleMap routing table.
Command: wkcv segment IMAGE --threshold 127 --min-area 100 --method contour
Wired proto: .tmp/wkcv-wired-proto.ps1 ready for promotion.
## Skill 3-Tier Structure
T1 core: wkcv-opencv-tools-t1-core (usage examples, command reference).
T2 howto: wkcv-opencv-tools-t2-howto (implementation spec, API, thresholds, methods).
T3 ref: wkcv-opencv-tools-t3-ref (this work record, measurements, test results).
## Dependencies Verified
opencv-python: cv2.imread, cv2.threshold, cv2.findContours, cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats
numpy: array manipulation, contour area/moment calculations.
PIL/Pillow (gaps module only): image format conversions.
pytesseract + Tesseract OCR (findtext module only).
## Production Deployment Status
Proto: bin/wkcv_segment.py (424 lines, zero syntax errors).
Launcher: wkcv.ps1 routing updated (wired proto in .tmp/).
Skills: Created T1/T2/T3 tiers with usage, spec, and measurements.
Next: Promote wkcv-wired-proto.ps1 to canonical bin/wkcv.ps1.
## Known Limitations & Future Work
- Threshold parameter is 0-255 fixed; consider adaptive threshold (--adaptive flag).
- No morphological operations (erode/dilate); could improve contour quality.
- Room analysis (wkcv_room.py) not yet integrated into segment analysis.
- Potential for GPU acceleration via CUDA if OpenCV compiled with it.
